markers.name: Acnovo
markers.yearly_cost: USD 30/mo (USD 360/yr)
markers.user_note: The server address and port are issued with the account, not published. The operator's coverage page also names further cities as being installed or planned, without dates.

markers.name: ACOR (American Center of Research)
markers.user_note: Run for the institute's own archaeological fieldwork; access is requested by e-mail rather than granted through a sign-up form.

markers.name: AD-GRS (Abu Dhabi GNSS Reference Stations)
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Access is arranged through TAMM, the emirate's general government-services portal, where the request sits in the business and construction track.

markers.name: DVRS (Dubai Virtual Reference Station)
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Dubai Municipality directs the service at surveyors and construction firms; the subscription is requested through its portal, and the correction credentials are issued manually rather than on sign-up.

markers.name: Afghanistan — no public network
markers.user_note: Three government reference stations built around 2008 were decommissioned by about 2011, and outside assistance for mapping work was suspended after the 2021 change of government.

markers.name: EarthScope Barbuda station
markers.user_note: The station's files reach the public through the US National Geodetic Survey's archive, where downloads need no account.

markers.name: Africa Geonetworks (AGL CORS)
markers.user_note: A Nairobi company advertising six base stations; its front page publishes a caster address, port and a shared login, but the caster has not answered from outside Kenya and the site publishes no usable price.

markers.name: AgrarNET
markers.yearly_cost: CHF 690/yr for the 1st licence, CHF 550 for a 2nd, both ex-VAT; plus CHF 140 for a data SIM
markers.user_note: Marketed for farm auto-steering, but the licence is sold on its own, with no farming or membership condition. The operator publishes no station list or reference frame, and does not say whether corrections come from a network or a single base.

markers.name: AgroNet RTK
markers.yearly_cost: 76,200 HUF/yr incl. VAT (~USD 242); 10 days' credit 11,430 HUF, usable within a year; 1 day 1,270 HUF
markers.user_note: Host and mountpoints arrive by e-mail after purchase rather than being published beforehand, and the stations behind the service are given as a live count on the landing page, not named or located.

markers.name: AGRS.BES (Kadaster Nederland)
markers.user_note: Where a station offers two mountpoint names, the short one is an older stream carrying GPS and GLONASS only; the longer name adds Galileo and BeiDou.
markers.datum_epoch: Bonaire 2004 = ITRF2000 (epoch 2001.5) on Bonaire; BES2020 = ITRF2014 (epoch 2020.0) on Saba and Sint Eustatius

creds.userNote: no account needed — an e-mail address here is optional, used only to notify you of outages

markers.name: ALBCORS
markers.yearly_cost: Per receiver: 60,000 lekë/yr (~USD 740) or 8,000 lekë/mo; user registration 2,000 lekë one-off.
markers.user_note: The tariff decree covers sales to individuals as well as firms, and no surveying licence is asked for. Sign-up is not self-service: the application form goes to ASIG by e-mail with a copy of an identity document.

markers.name: SAAP (Institut National de Cartographie et de Télédétection)
markers.user_note: Corrections travel over 3G VPN links on the national mobile networks, not the open internet, so there is no caster address to try; an account and one of the institute's VPN SIM cards come first, and the contact it gives is its commercial agency.

markers.name: AllDayRTK
markers.yearly_cost: From AUD 440/yr inc GST (~USD 290), 12-month term, 30-day free trial; other tiers on request. Aptella publishes no rates; the entry price is a dealer's.
markers.user_note: Three quarters of its Australian stations are government CORS that AUSCORS also streams free. The licence covers one device at a time, so a second rover needs a second subscription.
markers.datum_epoch: GDA2020(2020.0) or GDA94 — the caster hostname the rover connects to selects the frame

markers.name: ANCFCC – Réseau GNSS Permanent
markers.user_note: Building permanent reference stations is the agency's remit by law. It invoked that in 2022 to have the country's one private network, itri, shut down; itri's appeal to the Rabat administrative court has no published outcome.

markers.name: ANGOCORS
markers.yearly_cost: 96,000 AOA/yr (~USD 105) or 8,000 AOA/month — 1 device, 360 h/month; 360,000 AOA/yr (~USD 390) — 5 devices; 1,200,000 AOA/yr (~USD 1,305) — 15 devices. VAT basis not stated
markers.user_note: The operator's site advertises national coverage and its station map is demo data. Subscription is paid by transfer to an Angolan bank account, with the deposit slip uploaded in the account area.

markers.name: APOS — Austrian Positioning Service
markers.yearly_cost: €200/month, €20/day, or €0.0015/s; one-time €50 setup
markers.user_note: Free of charge to Austrian agricultural and forestry holdings.

markers.name: APOS-PP — Austrian Positioning Service post-processing data
markers.user_note: Free of charge and without registration. One-second data is kept for 60 days and 30-second data for two years; older 30-second files are supplied on request.

markers.name: ARMPOS
markers.user_note: Built for the state cadastre; the Cadastre Committee lists no positioning service among the national services it provides.

markers.name: ASG-EUPOS
markers.user_note: The form asks for a company or organisation name, though the full official name is not required, and asks nothing about nationality, tax number or Polish address. The NTRIP username becomes Company/user, and an administrator activates each account.

markers.name: AUSCORS
markers.region: Australia and New Zealand, plus partner stations re-streamed from dozens of other countries
markers.user_note: Geoscience Australia grants stream access per use-case: after the account form, its documentation asks new users to contact its team to arrange the permissions. Corrections are published under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence.
markers.datum_epoch: GDA2020(2020.0) on the Australian stations; re-streamed partner stations carry their own frame instead — Manus Island's is ITRF2020 (IGS20)

markers.name: Axis GPS
markers.yearly_cost: price on request

markers.name: AzPOS
markers.user_note: Individuals as well as companies may apply, and the terms of use are agreed between the operator and each applicant rather than published.

markers.name: FBiHPOS
markers.yearly_cost: 1,000 KM/yr (~USD 550); 100 KM one-off registration; 7 d 150 KM
markers.user_note: The online sign-up form requires a company name, an identity-card serial number and a Bosnian personal identification number; the downloadable paper application has a section for private individuals.

markers.name: SRPOS
markers.yearly_cost: 1,000 KM/yr (~USD 550); 250 KM/month; 30 KM/10 h
markers.user_note: A private person is asked for a company name and the rover's type and serial number; the company- and tax-number fields carry the operator's note that a natural person enters 007. Payment is by bank transfer; prepaid hours do not carry over.

markers.name: Survey of Bangladesh VRS
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The network-RTK product is computed from stations roughly 200 km apart.

markers.name: FLEPOS
markers.conditions_note: Only professional organisations may register, giving a Belgian or equivalent foreign company registration number. A one-person business qualifies; a private individual does not. The gate also covers the post-processing downloads.
markers.user_note: The terms exclude mass-consumer applications, naming grass robots and wearables. The operator dates the FLEPOS 4.0 renewal to end 2026 – early 2027 and flags a possible re-registration for existing users.

markers.name: GPSBru
markers.user_note: The caster address is not published: it arrives with the approved account, activated by return e-mail. The operator names only GPS and GLONASS in the RTK streams, GLONASS on one of the three.

markers.name: WALCORS
markers.region: Wallonia, Brussels and southern Flanders, with countrywide access
markers.user_note: Positioning is free; machine guidance (auto-steer) is a chargeable tier sold through private resellers. Beyond Brussels and southern Flanders the operator asks users to check their results themselves. Corrections are delivered only inside Belgium.

markers.name: BF-CORS
markers.user_note: The one sign-up address IGB gives, bfcors.net, stopped serving the network's portal in 2026, and no other route in has been published. IGB has never published terms or a price either, so there is no stated answer on who may hold an account.

markers.name: 1Yocto
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 640/yr, EUR 100/month, or EUR 55 for a 10-hour prepaid pack, all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: The operator takes orders by phone or e-mail rather than through an online checkout, and issues credentials after a bank transfer.

markers.name: GeoNet
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 600/yr unlimited, EUR 105/month, or EUR 15/month with 150 minutes on a 24-month term, all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Credentials are issued only after a contract is signed, and the tariff carries no prepaid hour pack.

markers.name: GEOVARA
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 615/yr, or EUR 410/yr for Hi-Target, Satlab and Topcon receivers; EUR 122.71/month; EUR 81.81 for 10 hours. All ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Subscriptions and hour packs are sold through a card checkout, so buying one does not require contacting the operator.

markers.name: HxGN SmartNet Bulgaria (СмартБул.Нет)
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 613.55/yr, EUR 122.71/month, or EUR 122.71 for a 20-hour prepaid pack, all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: The Bulgarian stations belong to Vekom Geo, which takes orders directly; its price page has no online checkout.

markers.name: National Permanent GNSS Network (НГИЦ)
markers.user_note: The stations record observation files for research, not real-time corrections. The operator describes the archive as freely available by file transfer, but publishes neither an address for it nor a way to request access.

markers.name: SLRB Permanent Reference Network
markers.user_note: Applying means emailing SLRB a form written for organisations, though Individual is an offered applicant type; credentials follow in 1-2 days and bring the caster address and mountpoint names with them. One device per credential.

markers.name: Burundi — no public RTK network
markers.user_note: Burundi's land-certification system is built at metre level by design: the government manual for communal land offices drops survey-grade instruments in favour of tablets and handheld GPS units, and states 3 m as the working accuracy.

markers.name: Ministerio de Bienes Nacionales
markers.user_note: No account and no form: the ministry simply publishes the files, each station with a coordinate sheet certified by the Instituto Geográfico Militar.

markers.name: IGN Bénin
markers.user_note: Access is granted on request to the institute, not through a signup page: the portal linked from ign.bj stopped answering in 2026, and no caster address appears on IGN's channels. The state catalogue also lists a service-desk route.

markers.name: Jabatan Ukur (Survey Department)
markers.user_note: The stations serve the department's own cadastral and mapping work. A public correction service has been proposed since 2011 and has never appeared in the department's published service catalogue.

markers.name: Department of Lands and Surveys reference network
markers.user_note: Built by Trimble, but no caster address, sign-up route or tariff for it has ever been published.

markers.name: DrukNet (NLCS)
markers.yearly_cost: Basic Nu. 10,000/year (~USD 120), one user; Standard Nu. 17,500, two users; Premium Nu. 22,500, three users
markers.user_note: The tiers count named users, not streams: one subscription holds a single connection at a time, regardless of tier. Teaching and research use is free against an official document proving the purpose.
markers.datum_epoch: DrukRef23 = ITRF2020 at epoch 2023.5, materialised by this network; the legacy cadastral frame DrukRef03 is reached through a national grid shift file. Heights on DrukGeoid 2015.

markers.name: Department of Surveys and Mapping
markers.user_note: Run as internal cadastral infrastructure. The department's public geospatial page handles map-product orders only — no sign-up, no caster address and no tariff for the station network.

markers.name: EFT CORS (Belarus)
markers.yearly_cost: Price on request — no Belarusian rate is published. The operator's Russian list is RUB 50,400/yr, RUB 5,250/month or RUB 420/day, incl. 5% VAT.
markers.user_note: Sign-up and billing run through the operator's Russian portal in roubles, and its account form marks a Russian-style tax number as required. Registered accounts are offered free download of base-station data for post-processing.

markers.name: Belgeodesiya
markers.yearly_cost: General plan, metered: 0.24 BYN/min ex-VAT, about 3,600 BYN for 250 h/yr (~USD 1,250). Flat plan 150.78 BYN/month ex-VAT (1,809 BYN/yr, ~USD 628), its tariff text written for vehicle-mounted equipment. One-hour RINEX file 3.63 BYN.
markers.user_note: The public contract covers Belarusian residents only; non-residents must negotiate a separate foreign-trade contract. There is no online sign-up — the contract is signed on paper and credentials are handed over in person in Minsk.

markers.name: Belgeodesiya RINEX (EUREF)
markers.user_note: No account and no contract: the daily 30-second observation files sit in an open EUREF archive, published under a Creative Commons attribution licence.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRF2000, epoch 2020.0 for the EUREF-published station positions; the owner's own service frame is ITRS realised as ITRF2005, epoch 2008-04-23

markers.name: BrandtNet
markers.yearly_cost: price on request

markers.name: City of Calgary DART
markers.user_note: The city publishes no service page, price or terms for the network, and the sign-up on its portal does not complete.

markers.name: Can-Net
markers.yearly_cost: price on request

markers.name: Capital Regional District RTK
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The regional district arranges access through its helpdesk.

markers.name: LATNET
markers.yearly_cost: CAD 1,000/yr; CAD 100/month
markers.user_note: The account is reviewed before use: credentials arrive by e-mail within a business day rather than at checkout. A seven-day trial takes no card.
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(CSRS) v6, with ITRF frames offered as an alternative

markers.name: Metro Vancouver GNSS Service
markers.yearly_cost: CAD 3,300/yr incl. tax; CAD 340/month incl. tax
markers.user_note: There is no online checkout: the subscription is a signed paper form returned by post with a cheque, it names the individuals allowed to use it, and it allows one connection at a time.

markers.name: Ville de Montréal RTK network
markers.user_note: The city publishes no subscription, price or caster address; the seven stations it owns do appear in the federal survey's archive, so their observation files can be downloaded there.

markers.name: Canadian Active Control System
markers.user_note: Downloads need a free account. The archive carries provincial and municipal reference stations alongside the federal ones, so a station whose live stream is sold elsewhere may still have free observation files here.
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(CSRS) epoch 2010.0 on the station reports, with ITRF realisations selectable per station

markers.name: Nova Scotia Active Control Stations
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The province runs the stations but sells no subscription itself: the real-time stream reaches a buyer only through survey dealers, each of which quotes rather than publishes a price.

markers.name: Prince Edward Island Active Control Network
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The province owns the stations but does not operate the network: SmartNet runs it, and subscriptions come from that company, not the province.

markers.name: Réseau géodésique du Québec
markers.user_note: The ministry reports latency problems on the server behind both of these streams.

markers.name: Réseau géodésique du Québec — raw-socket stations
markers.user_note: These bases each answer on their own port of a single ministry server with a raw RTCM stream and no mountpoint, so a rover reaches one only through a relay. The ministry's station table lists the address and port per city.

markers.name: SmartNet
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The operator runs a self-service online store with selectable subscription terms, but the price shows only after a buyer registers an account.

markers.name: TopNET Live
markers.yearly_cost: price on request

markers.name: WizNET
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The operator offers a free 30-day unlimited demo.

markers.name: CENACARTA
markers.user_note: Built for the national reference frame rather than for corrections; nothing has been published from these stations since 2015, and the agency's own website is no longer reachable.

markers.name: Centipede-RTK
markers.region: Europe, mostly France and Hungary, with scattered bases worldwide
markers.user_note: A base can stream before a reviewer has checked the position it declares; the operator's station map colours those still pending. Of the two shared mounts, NEAR4 carries a lighter message set for equipment that cannot take NEAR's.
markers.datum_epoch: France: RGF93 v2b = ETRF2000(2019.0). Outside France the operator prescribes a target frame per region — ETRF2000 in Europe, NAD83(CSRS) in North America, ITRF2020 elsewhere — and each base carries its own survey epoch.

markers.name: China Mobile OnePoint (移动CORS)
markers.yearly_cost: CNY 1,588/yr (~USD 220); CNY 168/month
markers.user_note: Resellers sell year accounts without asking for a surveying qualification; a direct China Mobile account needs a Chinese mobile number and a real-name identity check.
markers.datum_epoch: CGCS2000(2000.0), with ITRF2008(2016.0) and WGS84(2005.0) on other ports of the same caster

markers.name: RECI
markers.user_note: No caster address or sign-up route is published; use is arranged institutionally through the operator, BNETD-CIGN.

markers.name: International GNSS Service station YKRO
markers.user_note: Its files are downloaded from the international data centres that the linked station record lists.

markers.name: Government reference-station networks (national and provincial)
markers.user_note: Closed to individuals by law: the Surveying and Mapping Law (测绘法) reserves survey results for organisations holding a surveying qualification (测绘资质), and every provincial network applies the same gate.

markers.name: RoverConnect
markers.region: twelve states, not named by the operator
markers.yearly_cost: R$2.690/yr (~USD 529), R$355/mo (~USD 70), R$45/day (~USD 9) paying by PIX or bank slip; the same plans by card total R$2.988,89, R$394,44 and R$50
markers.user_note: Credentials are not issued at checkout: they arrive by e-mail or WhatsApp within about a day of the purchase being confirmed.

markers.name: IGN-CR (SNIT)
markers.user_note: New accounts activate at 00:00 or 12:00 local, up to 12 hours after signup. Mountpoints advertise only legacy GPS messages and no base coordinate, though the operator states every stream carries GPS, GLONASS, Galileo and BeiDou.
markers.datum_epoch: CR-SIRGAS — corrections are served in the operational frame ITRF2014, epoch 2019.24; the datum's official frame is IGb08, epoch 2014.59

markers.name: PX GNSS
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The operator presents the network as part of buying or renting its own equipment rather than as a subscription sold on its own.

markers.name: GEOCUBA NTRIP
markers.user_note: GEOCUBA's own 2024 account of the service frames it as serving priority sectors of the state economy; no caster address, sign-up route or tariff for it has been published.

markers.name: TUSAGA-Aktif (CORS-TR)
markers.yearly_cost: ₺8,135/yr (~$178) or ₺1,000/mo, VAT incl.; plus a one-off ₺550 device fee (~$12)
markers.user_note: Turkey's national reference-station network. Individual sign-up uses a Turkish national ID number (TC Kimlik No), and two signed copies of the user agreement must be posted to the operator.

markers.name: CyCLOPS
markers.user_note: A Cyprus University of Technology natural-hazard monitoring network that also carries RTK. The public is one of its listed user groups, and access is arranged with the university on request.

markers.name: CYPOS
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 238/yr, or EUR 142.80/6 mo, per receiver
markers.user_note: Sign-up runs through CY Login, the government identity account. Every identification route turns on a Cypriot ID card, a Cyprus residence permit or EU registration certificate, or a bank login the scheme recognises.

markers.name: CZEPOS
markers.yearly_cost: 10,000 CZK/yr per receiver (~USD 440); or 1,000 CZK/mo per receiver (~USD 44); or 60 CZK/hr (~USD 2.6)
markers.user_note: Signing up means a signed form sent by post, e-mail or data box rather than an online checkout. Students measuring for a thesis are exempt from the fee to the extent they need, on a request the school countersigns.

markers.name: GPSnet.dk
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Short-term access is sold in one-week, one-month and three-month terms.

markers.name: Klimadatastyrelsen GNSS
markers.user_note: Registration is a written request to the agency's geodesy office rather than a form; the invitation to write sets out no eligibility conditions and no terms of use.

markers.name: RTKconnect
markers.yearly_cost: 5,000 DKK/yr ex-VAT through the Agroassist reseller (6,250 DKK incl. 25% VAT, ~USD 910); 6,599 DKK/yr ex-VAT direct from the operator (8,249 DKK incl. VAT); 3,500 DKK/yr ex-VAT per access when buying several
markers.user_note: One login covers any number of devices. The cheapest channel has no checkout: the order goes by phone or e-mail, and the login is e-mailed back.

markers.name: Department of Lands & Survey Services
markers.user_note: The department publishes no access rule or application form for its stations; enquiries go to the Surveyor General.

markers.name: Dominica GNSSCORS
markers.user_note: Self-service sign-up has redirected to a maintenance error since June 2026, leaving new accounts to the operator, the Lands and Surveys Division.

markers.name: EarthScope NOTA
markers.region: the Americas, densest in the western US, with Alaska, Hawaii, the Caribbean and Mexico, plus a few stations in Rwanda and Nepal
markers.conditions_note: Free for personal, non-commercial use only. Charging any fee for work that uses these corrections, such as paid surveying or mapping, needs the commercial licence at about 1,000 US dollars per seat a year.
markers.datum_epoch: ITRF2014 on every stream; the NOTA stations carry a declared epoch of 2026-03-30, which the operator updates periodically, while the few stations outside NOTA carry best-estimate positions with no stated epoch

markers.name: Trimble VRS Now
markers.yearly_cost: from €1,195/yr unlimited ex-VAT (~€1,482 incl. 24% VAT); from €695/yr for 100 hours; from €2,995/yr Europe-wide; SIM card not included
markers.user_note: The cheaper H-Star and Net-dGNSS tiers on the same price list are not centimetre RTK.

markers.name: EFT CORS
markers.user_note: Basic access to the observation files is free with a registered account; extended access and the real-time corrections are paid.

markers.name: ANCFCC – Réseau GNSS Permanent
markers.user_note: The agency publishes no caster address and no price for anything these stations produce. Their data is sold as a catalogue item, across a counter at one of seven offices, none of them in the territory.

markers.name: EPOSA — Real-time Positioning Austria
markers.yearly_cost: €2,500/yr, €250/month or €25/day, all ex-VAT; one-time €50 setup
markers.user_note: Free for a 12-month period on an agricultural licence, against written proof of a holding and limited to farm use. There is no online sign-up: a signed application form goes to EPOSA by e-mail.
markers.datum_epoch: ITRF2020, epoch 2015.0 — a global frame rather than the Austrian ETRS89; the -ETRF mountpoints transform to ETRF2000 and the -TR mountpoints add the MGI grid correction

markers.name: ERGAND – PCAR
markers.user_note: The operator publishes PCAR's coordinates as provisional (in service since November 2024).

markers.name: ERGNSS / SPTR
markers.region: all of Spain, including the Balearics, the Canaries, Ceuta and Melilla
markers.user_note: IGN issues credentials by hand: the sign-up request goes to a service administrator and the password arrives by e-mail afterwards.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89 realised as ETRF2000 on the Peninsula, the Balearics, Ceuta and Melilla; REGCAN95 in the Canaries

markers.name: Egyptian Survey Authority reference network
markers.user_note: Nothing published says these stations broadcast corrections at all; the Authority sells maps and coordinate certificates. Its coordinates and observations are not released for outside use, so work tied to the network is bought from it as a service.

markers.name: ESTPOS
markers.user_note: Free access runs as a test period ending 31 August 2026, with nothing published about access after it. Corrections reach only internet addresses inside Estonia; access starts with a signed contract, and one account carries one connection at a time.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89 realised as EUREF-EST97 (parent ITRF96, epoch 1997.56); L-EST97 grid, EH2000 heights

markers.name: ESTPOS RINEX
markers.user_note: Files can be generated for a chosen point rather than only downloaded per station, and the portal holds the last 90 days. The operator has published no price for the service since its free period ended at the end of 2025.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89 realised as EUREF-EST97 (parent ITRF96, epoch 1997.56); L-EST97 grid, EH2000 heights

markers.name: ETCORS
markers.user_note: Inaugurated in December 2025. The Space Science and Geospatial Institute that runs it publishes no sign-up page or tariff; the only documented way in is direct contact.

markers.name: EUREF-IP (EUREF Permanent Network)
markers.region: Europe and its islands, from the Azores to Cyprus and north to Svalbard
markers.user_note: The sign-up wording calls these raw data, not RTK corrections — single-base streams a rover fixes off anyway. The network's own daily check flags about half the bases as more than 5 cm off the reference coordinate, some by metres.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89 realised as ETRF2000, at a coordinate epoch that steps to 1 January each year.

markers.name: FINPOS RTK
markers.user_note: The National Land Survey grants the real-time service only for fixed-term research and testing, and its terms exclude production use. Raw single-station data from the same stations is sold separately under contract, €163 a month per station, ex VAT.

markers.name: FINPOS RINEX
markers.user_note: Free to any registered user. Files can be generated for a chosen point rather than only downloaded per station; observations are kept at least nine months and generated files at least six.

markers.name: Karera RTKnet
markers.yearly_cost: €800/yr whole country; €500/yr agricultural licence, limited area
markers.user_note: Sold and priced through equipment dealers rather than by the operator, and ordered by phone, e-mail or contact form rather than a webshop. The published annual prices do not state a VAT basis.

markers.name: TOP RTK
markers.region: southern and western Finland, west of a Lappeenranta–Jämsä–Ähtäri–Perho–Kärsämäki–Pudasjärvi line
markers.yearly_cost: €650/yr ex-VAT, with a multi-operator SIM and 12 months of data included; installation extra
markers.user_note: Sold as a farm-machinery package; the operator does not say whether a receiver other than the machine equipment it is sold with can take the corrections.

markers.name: Umhvørvisstovan GNSS Network
markers.user_note: Access is arranged by contacting the agency, whose published offer addresses land-survey and construction firms. Free post-processing RINEX sits on Denmark's Dataforsyningen portal.

markers.name: Actisat
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Subscriptions are arranged directly with the operator by telephone or e-mail.

markers.name: IGN RGP-IP
markers.user_note: Access is by request to IGN rather than through a sign-up form. A station usually appears under several mountpoints carrying different correction formats, and some sites also stream raw receiver output.

markers.name: IGN RGP archive
markers.user_note: Most of its stations are the paid networks' own antennas, contributed under an IGN partnership. One-second hourly files are pruned after a few weeks; the daily 30-second file is what remains.

markers.name: Orphéon
markers.yearly_cost: €2,412/yr incl. VAT unlimited nationwide; 60 h over 12 months €756 incl. VAT; on-demand from €45 ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Annual subscriptions are sold through dealer agencies rather than by the operator, whose own shop carries short-duration access only — by the day, by the month, or in packages of a few hours.

markers.name: Satinfo
markers.yearly_cost: price on request; a dealer lists prepaid hour packages from €350, the hour count chosen at checkout
markers.user_note: Access comes as prepaid hour packages to be used within a year, as week, month or unlimited subscriptions, or priced by area from 300 km² up.

markers.name: Teria
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The network is run by Exagone, a company created in 2005 by the Ordre des Géomètres-Experts, the French chartered land-surveyors' body.

markers.name: FUNDCORSRD
markers.yearly_cost: RD$1,000/month (~USD 17) plus a one-off US$500 joining contribution, payable in pesos at the day's rate; one membership covers two simultaneous devices
markers.user_note: Membership is arranged directly with the foundation: the site's form only opens the request, and confirmation and the bank details follow over WhatsApp.

markers.name: GALNET (Cartogalicia)
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 500/yr or EUR 60/month, both ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Cartogalicia has no online signup: the service is arranged with the operator by e-mail or phone.

markers.name: CloudbaseRTK
markers.yearly_cost: £575/yr without a roaming SIM or £650 with one; £50 for a week or £15 for a day; VAT basis not stated
markers.user_note: The operator does not publish where its base stations stand, so distance to the nearest one cannot be checked before subscribing.

markers.name: CSEQ QNET
markers.region: farming areas across Great Britain, plus one base in Co. Wexford, Ireland
markers.yearly_cost: £120/yr per stream, ex VAT, or £330 ex VAT for three years; or £450–500 one-off for a base station to host, which makes that stream free
markers.user_note: The free-stream route is open only in areas the network has not reached; the host supplies mains power, wired internet and a clear sky, the unit stays CSEQ's property, and repeated outages can end the free stream.

markers.name: OS Net
markers.yearly_cost: £700 ex VAT for a Trimble VRS Now licence, term not stated by the retailer, or £750/yr with a roaming SIM; Leica SmartNet unlimited £2,592/yr incl VAT
markers.user_note: Ordnance Survey sells no corrections directly; each commercial partner sets its own price, terms and product name. Some of those products mix OS stations with the partner's own.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89 realised as EUREF IE/UK 2009 (parent ITRF97, epoch 2009.756); OSGB36 National Grid and Ordnance Datum Newlyn heights via OSTN15/OSGM15

markers.name: OS Net RINEX
markers.user_note: Downloads need a free OS Data Hub account on the OpenData plan; observations stay on the portal for about 45 days, with older files held in separate long-term archives.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89 realised as EUREF IE/UK 2009 (parent ITRF97, epoch 2009.756); OSGB36 National Grid and Ordnance Datum Newlyn heights via OSTN15/OSGM15

markers.name: RTKFnet
markers.yearly_cost: £525/yr without a data SIM or £650 with one, ex VAT, on the agriculture and drone tariff; construction, survey and marine work is priced separately at £900/yr
markers.user_note: There is no online checkout; a subscription is arranged through a dealer or a booked demonstration, and the service is presented as one for businesses and professionals.

markers.name: GEO-CORS
markers.region: Georgia, except Abkhazia and South Ossetia
markers.user_note: Host, port and mountpoint are issued per account, and registration alone does not produce them: a subscription must also be ordered from the operator's package shop. The sign-up form asks for no residency or nationality.
markers.datum_epoch: Georgian Geodetic Datum (GRS80), realised on ITRF2008/IGS08 at epoch 2011.353

markers.name: GEOCOM Red GNSS
markers.user_note: Neither a price nor a way to sign up is published: the survey-equipment distributor that runs the network handles access through its sales contact.

markers.name: Geomatica CORS RD
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Around a third of the stations it lists also stream free, without an account, on the open caster that carries REGNA-RD.

markers.name: Geo+
markers.region: São Paulo and the south-east, thinning through the south, north-east and centre-west, with nothing in the North
markers.yearly_cost: R$13/day on an annual plan, the operator's only published figure (~R$4,745/yr, ~USD 930); day, week and month plans are quoted on request
markers.user_note: Subscribing runs through a Guandalini representative rather than an online checkout.

markers.name: GeoRTK
markers.user_note: A large share of the caster's live streams publish no coordinates, appearing in the operator's mountpoint list as names only.

markers.name: GeoSpider
markers.yearly_cost: RUB 44,100/yr incl. 5% VAT (~USD 519); 1 month RUB 5,250; 1 day RUB 315 economy or RUB 525 unlimited
markers.datum_epoch: ITRF2008 (2013.39); the caster transforms output to a chosen local grid

markers.name: GeoNET (GeoTek PR)
markers.yearly_cost: USD 800/yr, or USD 80/month; USD 600/yr for owners of verified AlphaGEO equipment
markers.user_note: Corrections come from the nearest station through a single AUTO mountpoint, not from a network solution. A free 30-day trial runs before any payment; an annual plan is non-refundable once issued, while a monthly one can be cancelled at any time.

markers.name: Ghana CORS Net
markers.user_note: A Ghanaian surveyor's licence is required to register and to use the data. The portal sells observation files, downloaded or e-mailed, including files computed for a chosen position; the operator describes no real-time correction stream.

markers.name: Asiaq — Greenland Survey
markers.user_note: Nothing about this stream appears on the agency's own site — no terms, no price, no sign-up route — though its sourcetable declares it free; asking the agency directly is the only route on record.

markers.name: GNET
markers.user_note: The service has no page of its own: the caster's own record names gnss@kds.dk as the route to credentials, and publishes no terms. Station coordinates are GR96, frozen at 1996, about 0.6 m from a current global frame.

markers.name: GNET data archive
markers.user_note: Downloads need a free account. The town stations post daily, but most remote sites lost their satellite link to cost and are emptied on a maintenance visit each August, so their files can be a year old.

markers.name: Guyana Lands and Surveys Commission
markers.user_note: No caster address, service page or price is published for these stations, and the only enrolment route published is direct contact with the Commission's Head Office. Built for cadastral survey work, they were still being added to in 2025.

markers.name: GNSSnet.hu
markers.yearly_cost: 150,000 HUF/yr, 8 HUF/min single-base or 12 HUF/min network RTK, plus a one-off 12,000 HUF registration — all ex-VAT; ~USD 605/yr with 27% VAT
markers.user_note: Access needs a posted paper contract — three signed copies to Budapest, about five working days — and the contract is Hungarian only. Foreign buyers can instead take a 10-day pass for 10,000 HUF, renewable twice.

markers.name: Red CORS del Instituto Geográfico Nacional
markers.user_note: Files are ordered, not downloaded: one date and one 12-hour window per form, Q105 per 10 hours (about USD 14), paid in cash or by bank transfer. Before payment the form promises notice of whether the requested window's data exists.

markers.name: HEPOS
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 480/yr unlimited, ex-VAT; EUR 160 for 3 months; metered EUR 0.10/min plus EUR 10/month and a EUR 90 one-off registration
markers.user_note: Registration is open to individuals, not only to companies and public bodies. The operator also publishes the official transformation model between HTRS07 and the Greek national grid ΕΓΣΑ87 (GGRS87), and free software to apply it.
markers.datum_epoch: HTRS07, the Greek realisation of ETRS89 (ETRF2005, epoch 2007.5)

markers.name: HIVE
markers.yearly_cost: Price on request: per-station daily and hourly rates, listed on the operator's station map rather than as a price list
markers.user_note: The bases belong to the third-party owners who put them on the platform rather than to the operator itself.

markers.name: VRS Systems PR (HLCM Group)
markers.yearly_cost: price on request

markers.name: Instituto Geográfico Nacional (IGN Honduras)
markers.user_note: Station coordinates are not published; the geodesy unit issues them adjusted to the epoch of measurement.

markers.name: HOSAC FREE RTK
markers.region: Hokkaido and scattered sites elsewhere in Japan
markers.user_note: The operator sells auto-steer hardware, but states the free service is open to anyone with an NTRIP-format receiver. Host, port and mountpoint are issued by email after registration rather than published.

markers.name: CROPOS
markers.user_note: A one-off €40 registration fee is charged with the application, which is a signed form returned by e-mail, fax or post; its applicant block asks for a Croatian OIB identification number.
markers.datum_epoch: HTRS96 — the Croatian ETRS89 realisation, epoch 1995.55 — on the HTRS96-named network mounts; the HDKS-named ones carry the legacy Croatian state grid instead. The station coordinates the single-base mounts broadcast are held in ETRF2000(R05), measurement epoch 2008.83

markers.name: HxGN SmartNet Greece
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 360/yr unlimited single-base, ex-VAT; EUR 720/yr unlimited network RTK; EUR 125/yr for 20 hours of network RTK
markers.user_note: There is no online checkout: a subscription is ordered from the operator, then activated by hand during a fixed window on working days. A seven-day trial licence is free.
markers.datum_epoch: HTRS07, matched to the national HEPOS network

markers.name: HxGN SmartNet Italy (ItalPOS)
markers.region: all of Italy including Sicily and Sardinia
markers.yearly_cost: €385/yr ex-VAT (ItalPOS tier); ~€470/yr incl. VAT

markers.name: HxGN SmartNet North America
markers.yearly_cost: price on request; the operator's own page cites about USD 2,400/yr for a one-state subscription
markers.user_note: Nationwide coverage rests on the operator's self-declared service polygon; per-locale station density is not published and the station map is account-gated. A free trial is offered.
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(NA2011); epoch 2010.00 except in high-velocity areas, where the operator applies an alternate epoch

markers.name: HxGN SmartNet Netherlands
markers.yearly_cost: €1,297/yr ex-VAT unlimited; €538/yr ex-VAT for 120 hours; €324/yr ex-VAT for 60 hours; mobile SIM not included
markers.user_note: A Dutch subscription has no web checkout — the prices are published, but the order goes through a quote request. The reseller shows them without VAT to business accounts and with VAT to private ones.

markers.name: ichimill (SoftBank)
markers.yearly_cost: ¥39,600/yr incl-tax (~USD 265); nearest-station tier ¥3,000/mo ex-tax; VRS tier ¥18,000/mo ex-tax
markers.user_note: SoftBank fronts the service as a corporate product, yet retail resellers sell single-device annual licences to individuals. The VRS tier is tied to the national control-point network, the cheaper tier to SoftBank's own stations.

markers.name: InaCORS
markers.user_note: Sign-up asks for a company name and mobile number, then a checkout that orders the free corrections as a subscription. The datum is semi-dynamic: the operator publishes a deformation model carrying coordinates from its epoch to the measurement date.

markers.name: CSEQ QNET
markers.region: the area within about 30 km of Wexford
markers.yearly_cost: €143.95/yr ex VAT; €393.95 for three years; €357.95/yr with a multi-network SIM. The euro figures are converted from the operator's sterling prices (£120/yr ex VAT).
markers.user_note: The operator's coverage checker takes UK postcodes only, so an Eircode gets no answer; its browser-location button answers for any position.

markers.name: JL Agnet
markers.region: the crop-growing areas of eastern, southeastern and midland Ireland
markers.yearly_cost: €650/yr or €400 for 6 months, ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Joining asks for an auto-steer system unlocked for RTK that accepts NTRIP, plus a modem holding the multi-network SIM the operator supplies. The operator gives no base positions; a free three-day trial precedes subscription.

markers.name: Tailte Éireann / OSNI Active GNSS
markers.user_note: The archive holds only the last 30 days of data. Real-time corrections from the same stations are sold by other companies, not by the operator.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89 (IRENET95), epoch 1995.0; station coordinates published in Irish Transverse Mercator

markers.name: IGAC MAGNA-ECO
markers.user_note: Registration is self-service, but the NTRIP subscription is a separate request IGAC approves by hand; the network streams named after departments, on caster port 2101, need no credentials at all.
markers.datum_epoch: MAGNA-SIRGAS 2018 = ITRF2014 (2018.0) is the national frame; the active network's station coordinates follow the current ITRF, not the frozen 2018.0 realisation.

markers.name: IGN REGNA-RD
markers.user_note: The free streams come from a SIRGAS caster in Ecuador that labels itself experimental, not from the institute's own infrastructure. REGNA-RD is a certification umbrella over 66 stations under five owners, each controlling its own access.

markers.name: IGS-IP
markers.region: worldwide IGS reference stations, around 105 countries, often one or two per country

markers.name: Venezuela — no government RTK network
markers.user_note: The state reference network (REMOS) was retired station by station and none has run since 2020. Adverts still call it a free national service, and no volunteer or university caster streams in its place.

markers.name: Andhra Pradesh State CORS
markers.user_note: Survey of India and the state signed an agreement in October 2025 to fold these stations into the national network.

markers.name: Survey of India CORS
markers.yearly_cost: ₹30,320/6 months (~USD 318); ₹15,096/3 months (~USD 158); ₹5,000/month (~USD 52) — all ex-GST
markers.user_note: Real-time service for Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu is handled by those state governments, not by this subscription. Registration needs an Indian photo ID. The fee is waived for government bodies and government academic institutions.

markers.name: Tamil Nadu State CORS
markers.user_note: Built for the state's own cadastral resurvey rather than sold as a correction service.

markers.name: National GNSS network (INGT)
markers.user_note: The five stations exist to tie the national survey vertices to the global frame; their operator releases those vertex coordinates on request, under an agreed procedure.

markers.name: IGRS (Iraqi Geodetic Reference System)
markers.user_note: Built in 2005 under the State Commission on Survey. No correction stream or data portal has been published, and Iraqi geodetic studies work from archived station observations instead.

markers.name: SHAMIM Plus
markers.user_note: The sign-up form asks for an Iranian national identity number, a mobile number and the rover's serial number, and a new account waits on land-registry approval before it works. Neither the portal nor the caster answers from outside Iran.

markers.name: IceCORS
markers.user_note: Access is requested by e-mail rather than through a sign-up form; the operator asks for a company name, a contact name and an e-mail address. No licence, professional qualification or Icelandic identity number is asked for.
markers.datum_epoch: ISN2016 (IGS14, epoch 2016.5); the Reykjanes bases SENG and GEVK instead use reference coordinates at epochs 2023-11-29 and 2024-02-23

markers.name: gFIX.net (National Land Agency)
markers.user_note: No user fee is published anywhere, but the portal's login demands an organisation. The network solution comes only in Trimble CMR and RTCM 2.3, so a rover that speaks only RTCM 3 gets nothing from it; seven bases also stream RTCM 3 on their own.

markers.name: Drogger Ntrip Caster
markers.user_note: Bases are built by the operator's customers, and BizStation says their positions need not agree with national coordinates; it confirms that agreement only for the smaller NEAR-TRUST tier, and rates NEAR-FIXED accuracy as unknown.
markers.datum_epoch: Per base, self-declared in the caster's station list — JGD2011, JGD2024 or 'current'; no network-wide frame.

markers.name: GEONET (GSI)
markers.user_note: The 1-second real-time stream is licensed only through paid distribution agencies, so there is no public RTK caster behind these stations. Applicants outside Japan register through a separate written application.
markers.datum_epoch: JGD2011 (semi-dynamic); the 2024 realisation revised heights at reference epoch 2024-06-01

markers.name: Khmer GEONET
markers.user_note: The operator runs this as a test phase and has extended the free period repeatedly rather than setting a tariff; posted end dates have lapsed without a price being published.

markers.name: KollNET
markers.yearly_cost: CLP 450,000/yr (~USD 490); 30 days CLP 85,000 (~USD 92); 7 days CLP 48,000 (~USD 52), all ex-IVA
markers.user_note: Nothing is sold online — the operator gives only an e-mail address and telephone numbers as a way in, and publishes no caster address or mountpoint name.

markers.name: KPLC CORS Services
markers.yearly_cost: KES 626,400/yr (~USD 4,850), KES 52,200/month, KES 290/hour — VAT included
markers.user_note: Sign-up is self-service and asks for no survey qualification, though the portal's own copy addresses professional surveyors. M-Pesa is the only payment channel, and the phone field expects a +254 number.

markers.name: GNSS Data Center
markers.user_note: The account is deleted after 50 days without a login.

markers.name: NGII Network RTK
markers.user_note: Sign-up runs through the operator's Korean identity check. Each account carries one connection at a time, though one membership can hold several accounts.

markers.name: KSA-CORS
markers.user_note: Connections from outside Saudi Arabia are dropped before any credential is exchanged. Registration is reviewed by GEOSA before approval, and the account details arrive by e-mail rather than at the end of the form.

markers.name: PACI (Public Authority for Civil Information) / Kuwait Municipality
markers.user_note: Access is limited to licensed surveying firms working under a government or municipal contract; the operator publishes no individual subscription at any price.

markers.name: Cayman Lands & Survey CORS
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: There is no online signup: a subscription is arranged with the Chief Surveyor, and the connection details are issued to subscribers rather than published.

markers.name: Cayman Lands & Survey RINEX
markers.user_note: Government stations shared with the paid real-time service, published by NOAA's National Geodetic Survey rather than by Lands & Survey; downloads need no account.
markers.datum_epoch: Station coordinates come in two realisations: NOAA publishes ITRF2014 at epoch 2010.0 with velocities, the operator CIGD11 (ITRF2005 at epoch 2011.0).

markers.name: KyrPOS
markers.yearly_cost: 23,214 KGS/yr per receiver (~USD 265); 3,180 KGS/month (~USD 36)
markers.user_note: Neither sign-up route asks for a professional qualification. The operator's price table lists a day rate; its service page requires a contract term of at least a month and prices the day differently.

markers.name: EFT GROUP
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Raw observation data for post-processing is free once an account is registered.

markers.name: LatPos
markers.user_note: Registration alone opens no stream: a product is ordered in the portal's shop, then switched on by an administrator within a stated three working days. Port and mount follow the product ordered, and Galileo is a product of its own.
markers.datum_epoch: LKS-92; the operator declares only the Latvian coordinate system currently in force, and LKS-2020 (ETRS89, epoch 2020.28) takes that role on 1 October 2026

markers.name: Lebanon — no public network
markers.user_note: The mapping mandate sits with the army's geographic directorate, whose published work is the national triangulation and grid rather than reference stations, and no correction-network programme has been announced.

markers.name: LitPOS
markers.user_note: Sign-up is not a form on the operator's site — the service is ordered through the state portal TPS Vartai, which signs users in by Lithuanian bank login or electronic ID. Its Lithuanian pages warn that logins issued there are not yet valid.

markers.name: CORSnet
markers.yearly_cost: price on request

markers.name: SLCORSnet
markers.yearly_cost: 360,000 LKR/year per receiver (~USD 1,075), all taxes in; 30 days 30,000 LKR (~USD 90); 1 day 2,000 LKR (~USD 6)
markers.user_note: Payment is a cash deposit at the operator's bank, with the slip emailed or faxed in; an account activates about 28 hours after the payment is confirmed — the one-day pass included.
markers.datum_epoch: SLD99 (Sri Lanka Datum 1999, Everest 1830), transformed from WGS 84 live inside the stream; SLD99 differs from current ITRF by about 1.9 m in height.

markers.name: SPSLux
markers.user_note: The sign-up form marks company and contact name as required fields, though the operator's service pages state no professional or organisational condition for an account.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89/ETRF2000 at epoch 2020.82 (LUREF2020); from 31 October 2026 epoch 2025.83 (LUREF2025), when the operator's new station coordinates take effect

markers.name: Libya — no public RTK network
markers.user_note: Two rival governments have run the country since 2014. The Tripoli survey department is active and mandated to build permanent stations, but the national frame it publishes rests on ground markers, not on anything that broadcasts.

markers.name: MARGEN-ROC
markers.user_note: The download request form asks for a Bolivian identity-card (CI) number and offers no foreign-document alternative. Availability is per station and per date — not every station holds every day.

markers.name: MOLDPOS
markers.yearly_cost: RTK 100 252 MDL/mo (~USD 14, 100 min); RTK 400 828 MDL/mo (~USD 47, 400 min); RTK PRO unlimited 2,208 MDL/mo (~USD 125)
markers.user_note: The operator's connection page publishes a shared login. It authenticates, but the caster then refuses to serve corrections to any rover position in the country, reporting it as outside the assigned geographical region.

markers.name: ROMPOS
markers.region: the areas within about 30 km of Edineț, Fălești, Nisporeni, Leova and Comrat
markers.yearly_cost: 1,000 RON/yr or 100 RON/mo per device. VAT incl. (~USD 215/yr)
markers.user_note: The five Moldovan mounts are single-base streams carrying GPS and GLONASS only: ROMPOS publishes a four-constellation MSM version for its Romanian stations, but not for these.

markers.name: MontePN
markers.user_note: A university research project's caster: the streams stay up behind a password, while the project site that once carried its registration form now shows only a placeholder.

markers.name: MontePN RINEX (EUREF station DGOR)
markers.user_note: The observation files download anonymously from the open EUREF archives under a Creative Commons attribution licence. Only 30-second daily files are published, no hourly and no high-rate, so a session waits for its UTC day to close.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRF2000 at epoch 2020.0 for the EUREF-published DGOR position; Montenegro's own national system is tied to ITRS.

markers.name: MontePos
markers.yearly_cost: €1,000/yr; €250/month; €100/24 h, all per receiver
markers.user_note: The application is a signed paper form asking for a company name, registration number and tax number, with the fee paid by bank transfer; the caster address and login are released only afterwards.
markers.datum_epoch: ITRS on the GRS80 ellipsoid — the national system defined by the survey and cadastre law, realised by the CGREF network together with MontePos

markers.name: Metta CORS
markers.yearly_cost: USD 300/yr, USD 30/mo, USD 1,200/5yr
markers.user_note: A subscription also covers raw observation data for post-processing, downloaded in three-hour windows.

markers.name: MI-GLIS
markers.yearly_cost: USD 3,300/yr entry package, the 12-month contract billing 11 months; USD 300/month, 65 login hours included, then USD 10/h; sworn surveyors USD 1,650/yr. VAT basis not stated
markers.user_note: No caster address is published; it arrives with the signed contract. The form for applicants who are not sworn surveyors has a block for a natural person, but asks for a Chamber of Commerce extract and a company signatory.

markers.name: MIRAI / Go!GNSS
markers.region: around 40 countries worldwide, most of the stations in Australia and New Zealand, elsewhere a few per country
markers.user_note: Streams carry no base-station coordinate and published station coordinates run as coarse as ~11 m, so absolute accuracy rests on a base position sourced elsewhere. Use requires crediting the source; accounts lapse after 365 idle days.

markers.name: MAKPOS
markers.yearly_cost: 54,300 MKD/yr for a user's first registered receiver (~USD 1,005), 48,800 for a second; 7,008 MKD/month; 15 MKD/minute — statutory tariff, 2020 text, amended twice since
markers.user_note: An April 2020 operator notice that the Galileo-capable network solution carries no charge is easy to read as MAKPOS being free: what it waives is a surcharge for users already paying the tariff, not the tariff itself.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89 realised as ETRF2000, epoch 2010.631; the MKD_GRID and MKD_GRID_QGEO mountpoints instead output the national state coordinate system, MKD_GRID_QGEO with MK_HREF2022 quasi-geoid heights

markers.name: Survey Department reference network
markers.user_note: Built in 2019 for the national reference frame and introduced for departmental use in 2021. No address, sign-up route or tariff for it has been published.

markers.name: MonPOS
markers.user_note: No mountpoint carries Galileo or BeiDou; the caster lists GPS and GLONASS streams only.

markers.name: MoSRef
markers.user_note: A portal account alone does not open the stream. Access is granted on a separate application: a form signed and stamped by an organisation's head, itemising each receiver and antenna by make, model and serial number. Approval lapses after a year.

markers.name: Muya CORS
markers.region: Kenya apart from Marsabit, Wajir and Mandera, plus three stations over the Ugandan border
markers.yearly_cost: KES 240,000/yr (12 × KES 20,000/month, ~USD 1,860), KES 4,000/day, KES 200/hour in 2-8 h blocks — per device, VAT included
markers.user_note: Rates and the caster host and port are no longer posted publicly; both come with a client account. The operator's terms run a one-year auto-renewing agreement even where hours or days are sold.

markers.name: GeoCORS
markers.yearly_cost: MXN 13,920/yr incl IVA (~USD 815), MXN 1,392/mo, MXN 232/day on the operator's own portal; the Survey+ MX reseller channel prices the same network higher and by receiver brand
markers.user_note: The caster address is issued only after payment, and the licence itself arrives over WhatsApp.

markers.name: INEGI RGNA
markers.user_note: Third-party guides name an NTRIP caster address for this network; INEGI publishes no real-time corrections, only the file archive. Downloads need no account — the page prints the download server's username and password.

markers.name: Red CORS México
markers.yearly_cost: MXN 20,416/yr (~USD 1,195) or MXN 2,042/mo through the Aeros dealer channel — reference prices a dealer confirms by WhatsApp before sale, neither stating whether IVA is included
markers.user_note: Several dealers resell this one network under identical copy, so it appears under many brand names in searches. New users get seven days of corrections free.

markers.name: MyRTKnet
markers.yearly_cost: RM 1,000/year (~USD 225)
markers.user_note: One login drives one receiver at a time; each renewal is a fresh application, not an extension. Post-processed RINEX is priced apart from the subscription, at RM 1 a minute for a virtual station or RM 2 an hour for a reference station.

markers.name: mynet.
markers.yearly_cost: €850/yr ex-VAT (~€1,054 incl. 24% VAT)
markers.user_note: The operator publishes neither a station list nor a coverage map.

markers.name: Qazgeodesy (NCGPI)
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Any registered account can read the tariff table, and sign-up takes a Kazakh tax number, personal or company. A subscription is priced by how many reference stations it covers and how many rovers connect.

markers.name: NetGEO (TopNET Live)
markers.user_note: Sales are restricted to holders of an Italian partita IVA, the value-added-tax registration carried by businesses and self-employed professionals.

markers.name: NIGNET / MIRAnet
markers.user_note: The portal's account form asks for no licence and names no price. The caster last answered in July 2026, listing five mountpoints with no coordinates; it did not answer when checked in August 2026.

markers.name: OTIC CORS Network
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The same stations have also been marketed under the Geossotech name. There is no self-service signup: access is arranged with the operator by phone or e-mail.

markers.name: INETER (Instituto Nicaragüense de Estudios Territoriales)
markers.user_note: The file request form asks for an identity number before it will release data — a Nicaraguan identity card, a residence card or a passport, so a foreign document is accepted.

markers.name: 06-GPS
markers.yearly_cost: €1,500/yr ex-VAT; €150/month ex-VAT; €1.00 per connected minute ex-VAT with no subscription
markers.user_note: Kadaster and Rijkswaterstaat certify its reference-station coordinates. A one-month RTK trial subscription is free, once.

markers.name: AGRS.NL
markers.user_note: Every site also publishes a receiver-native raw stream, its mountpoint name one character from the usable one and carrying no corrections; a few sites keep an older short-named stream that is GPS and GLONASS only.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRF2000(R05) @ 2010.5 — the AGRS2010 realisation of ETRS89; stations rebuilt since are computed at their own epoch and tied into AGRS2010

creds.userNote: no account needed — an e-mail address here is optional, used only to notify you of service changes

markers.name: LNR Net
markers.yearly_cost: €1,500/yr, €200/month or €50/day; months and days are billed only for the periods actually used
markers.user_note: A 30-day demo account is free and is requested on an intake form.

markers.name: MoveRTK
markers.user_note: Its terms supply the service only for machine guidance in farming, road building and earthmoving, not for ordinary RTK rovers or for setting out and measuring up; the sign-up form itself asks nothing about intended use.

markers.name: NETPOS
markers.user_note: Kadaster does sell the raw stream of a single station, at €475 a year and priced per station, through a form that needs a Dutch business login; private and overseas buyers are directed to a contact form instead.

markers.name: RTK-GPS.nl
markers.yearly_cost: €225/yr ex-VAT including a KPN SIM and its data; €20 off if you bring your own SIM; €195/yr ex-VAT per system from the second
markers.user_note: Four of its bases are rebroadcast Kadaster stations, which stream free direct from Kadaster. Its order page lists the receiver brands it supports and asks buyers of anything else to make contact before ordering.

markers.name: RTKned
markers.user_note: Its terms supply the service only for machine guidance in farming, road building and earthmoving, and rule out survey work, ordinary RTK rovers, and setting out and measuring up.

markers.name: NLSC e-GNSS
markers.yearly_cost: NT$300 per receiver per day (~USD 9); NT$2,000 membership permit for five years (~USD 63)
markers.user_note: Membership is open to organisations only: the form is rejected without a government-agency seal or a company chop, and a company must attach proof of its registration.

markers.name: CPOS
markers.yearly_cost: NOK 11,000/yr ex-VAT Standard, 1-3 subs (~USD 1,150); NOK 8,000/yr 4+ subs; NOK 5,000/yr agriculture
markers.user_note: The order form requires a company name on every tier, the one-month trial included, and a corporate registration number from new customers. Kartverket's terms grant free access for thesis work and to pre-commercial startups, on application.
markers.datum_epoch: EUREF89 (Norway's ETRS89 realisation), ~epoch 1989.0; ellipsoidal heights referred to 1995.0; vertical NN1954/NN2000

markers.name: NOANET (National Observatory of Athens)
markers.user_note: Downloads are anonymous; the operator asks that any use of the data and metadata carry its published citations. The archive holds daily 30-second files, with other sampling intervals supplied on request.

markers.name: EarthScope Chitwan station (CHWN)
markers.user_note: Downloads need a free EarthScope account, as the operator's live streams do. The station records at 15-second intervals, not 1 Hz.

markers.name: AllDayRTK
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: About half its New Zealand stations are LINZ CORS, the same government bases PositioNZ-RT streams free. A 30-day trial runs on self-service registration.

markers.name: OmanCORSnet
markers.user_note: Royal Decree 43/2026 requires prior official approval for terrestrial survey work but leaves the term to executive regulations, so its reach over private RTK work is undefined. The caster offers GPS and GLONASS only, no Galileo or BeiDou.

markers.name: OTC (Office de la Topographie et du Cadastre)
markers.yearly_cost: 6,000 TND/yr (~USD 2,050); 840 TND/30 days (~USD 287); 60 TND/day (~USD 21), all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: The subscription form asks for a tax registration number, and the users OTC names as eligible are its own districts, private surveyors and public bodies; individuals are neither listed nor excluded. The caster address arrives with the credentials.

markers.name: Instituto Geográfico Nacional Tommy Guardia
markers.user_note: There is no sign-up: the page publishes a single login that all users share, and the archive is reached with a file-transfer (sFTP) client rather than a web download.
markers.datum_epoch: ITRF2008 realised as SIRGAS SIR11P01, epoch 2005.0

markers.name: TOPORED (Casa del Topógrafo)
markers.user_note: A surveying-equipment dealer runs the network. Its page publishes no price and no sign-up route, and the login there is for observation files. The only access path it has advertised comes bundled with buying a receiver.

markers.name: Pegaso VRS Now
markers.region: all of Italy including Sardinia and Sicily
markers.yearly_cost: €449/yr (RTK VRS); €499/yr with RINEX; €699/yr with coordinate transform
markers.user_note: Certified by the Istituto Geografico Militare, the national mapping institute that maintains Italy's reference frame; the network is a joint venture with Trimble, which runs it and sells the subscriptions.

markers.name: AllDayRTK
markers.yearly_cost: Aptella publishes no rate; its Australian entry tier is reported at AUD 440/yr inc GST (~USD 290), annual contract only
markers.user_note: This station is a Theodist installation carried on Aptella's caster; Aptella's own product and sign-up pages do not name Papua New Guinea.

markers.name: AllDayRTK
markers.yearly_cost: Aptella publishes no rate; its Australian entry tier is reported at AUD 440/yr inc GST (~USD 290), annual contract only
markers.user_note: This station is a Theodist installation carried on Aptella's caster; Aptella's own product and sign-up pages do not name Papua New Guinea.

markers.name: Geoscience Australia GNSS Data Centre
markers.user_note: Files download without an account. PNG94, the 1994 national datum that older survey marks carry, is ITRF92 at epoch 1994.0 and now sits up to about 2 metres from the archive's frame.

markers.name: PAGeNet
markers.yearly_cost: PHP 12,000/month (~USD 212); PHP 100/hour per station per rover (~USD 1.77); one-time PHP 1,000 registration
markers.user_note: Payment runs through the NAMRIA cashier in Metro Manila or a LandBank deposit, not the website. Observation files for post-processing are free at 30–60 s sampling, PHP 50 per megabyte at 1–20 s.
markers.datum_epoch: PGD2020, aligned with ITRF2014 at epoch 2020.044; corrections are also offered in WGS84 (2010 adjustment) and in the original WGS84

markers.name: Pivotpos
markers.yearly_cost: 900 RON/yr, 150 RON/mo, or 50 RON/7 days (~USD 195/yr)
markers.user_note: The station roster is not fixed: the operator's own sensor map shed nine of its 59 stations during July 2026.

markers.name: SUPARCO Pak-Rehber
markers.user_note: Pak-Rehber and Pak-GBAS are two labels for the same platform, not two separate networks.

markers.name: PositioNZ-RT
markers.user_note: LINZ puts the recommended working range at 15 km from the station a rover connects to. The caster carries more than the PositioNZ CORS — GeoNet monitoring sites and tide gauges stream on the same free login.

markers.name: PrinNet
markers.yearly_cost: RUB 48,800/yr (~USD 574); 1 month RUB 4,880; 1 day RUB 366
markers.user_note: Sign-up and card payment are open to private individuals with no company account, and the first five days are free.

markers.name: Red Sísmica de Puerto Rico (Puerto Rico Seismic Network)
markers.region: Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands
markers.user_note: The caster's host and port are not published: both arrive by e-mail with the login. Streams are RTCM 3.0, which carries no Galileo or BeiDou, and the operator guarantees neither availability nor quality.

markers.name: Palestine — no public network
markers.user_note: No Palestinian authority runs a correction service and no donor programme has announced one; the Israeli networks that reach the territory publish no access terms for a Palestinian subscriber.

markers.name: RAMSAC RINEX (IGN Argentina)
markers.user_note: The station's Trimble NetR9 logs GPS and GLONASS only, so the files hold no Galileo or BeiDou. Downloads need no account; IGN's terms require attribution and that the data be passed on free of charge.

markers.name: QCORS (Qatar Continuously Operating Reference Stations)
markers.user_note: Subscription is by direct application to the ministry's centre for geographic information, not self-service: government bodies free, registered companies paid at an unpublished rate. Its published terms name no individual subscriber.

markers.name: Qianxun FindCM (千寻知寸)
markers.yearly_cost: CNY 3,600/yr (~USD 500); CNY 400/month
markers.user_note: The centimetre tier is nominally sold only to organisations holding a Chinese surveying qualification; resellers issue individual year accounts anyway.

markers.name: RAMSAC-NTRIP
markers.user_note: Connections are capped at 8 hours each, with up to 3 running simultaneously per login.

markers.name: RBMC-IP
markers.user_note: Sign-up needs a gov.br account, keyed to a Brazilian taxpayer number (CPF); approval takes about a working day, and one account may use five stations. Fewer stations stream on a given day than the roster declares.

markers.name: RED-GEO
markers.region: La Paz, Cochabamba, Oruro, Tarija, Ivirgarzama and the Santa Cruz area
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: No online signup: a login is arranged by telephone with the operator. An annual subscription switches between any station in the network.
markers.datum_epoch: MARGEN-SIRGAS (ITRF2020), by tie to the national reference stations

markers.name: Saint Petersburg reference station network
markers.user_note: Access is sold to organisations under contract.

markers.name: REGME-IP
markers.user_note: The signup form asks for an institution but no identity document, surveying qualification or fee, and its country list is worldwide. The terms allow commercial use of work made with the corrections, but not resale of the corrections themselves.

markers.name: REGNA-ROU (Instituto Geográfico Militar)
markers.user_note: A station's plain mount carries GPS and GLONASS. Where a station also lists a mount with MSM in its name, that one adds Galileo and usually BeiDou. Not every station publishes one.

markers.name: REGPMOC (Instituto Geográfico Nacional del Perú)
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The use policy covers private individuals as well as companies, but there is no self-service sign-up: the institute's geodesy office issues credentials by e-mail once the fee is paid.

markers.name: ReNEP
markers.region: mainland Portugal, the Azores and Madeira
markers.user_note: DGT reviews each application before issuing access, and the username and password then arrive by e-mail; the form asks for the applicant's equipment and an institution or company.
markers.datum_epoch: ETRS89 realised as ETRF97, epoch 1995.4, on the mainland; ITRF93, epoch 1994.0, in the Azores and Madeira

markers.name: REPANGOL
markers.user_note: Built in 2010 to realise the national reference frame rather than to serve corrections. Its public face was a login-gated monitoring portal, and its station data reached public archives until about 2015.

markers.name: REPCAN (GRAFCAN)
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Real-time corrections are billed as an annual licence per connecting device, ordered through an invoicing form rather than a self-service signup.

markers.name: REPGRAM
markers.user_note: The portal publishes no caster address; it comes with the account. Its certificate is expired, so browsers flag the site as insecure. An account left unused for six months can be suspended after notice.

markers.name: REPRAA
markers.user_note: The Azores regional government's geodesy division runs its own permanent reference stations, separate from the national ReNEP. Its portal has been offline in 2026, and no price or terms for the network are published elsewhere.

markers.name: RGAC (Red Activa de Estaciones GNSS de Cantabria)
RGAPA (Red GNSS Activa del Principado de Asturias)
Rwanda Geodetic Network
markers.user_note: Rwanda's National Land Authority states it distributes the data free of charge, but its only published account of the network describes post-processed use, names no connection point, and leaves a direct request as the way in.

markers.name: RTK Premium
markers.yearly_cost: 800 RON/yr, 500 RON/6 months, or 300 RON/3 months, VAT incl. (~USD 172/yr)
markers.user_note: A Dutch operator's Europe-wide service sold through a Romanian channel: the station count quoted is continental, and neither site names a station in Romania. A five-day free trial is offered.

markers.name: ROMPOS
markers.yearly_cost: 1,000 RON/yr or 100 RON/mo per device. VAT incl. (~USD 215/yr)
markers.user_note: The tariff order behind the price attaches no profession, licence or company condition; the sign-up is an ordinary web account with the national cadastre agency, ANCPI.

markers.name: AGROS
markers.yearly_cost: 145,480 RSD/yr (~USD 1,410); 47,660 RSD/yr (~USD 460) on the agricultural and construction machinery tier; 26,440 RSD/month — statutory administrative fee, amounts in force from 1 July 2026
markers.user_note: The machinery tier is set by the equipment it serves, not by a profession or licence, and the statute attaches no eligibility test to it. The fee is charged per receiver, each further receiver on one annual account costing 10% less than the last.

markers.name: GentooARS
markers.yearly_cost: 65,000 RSD/yr (~USD 630); 25,000 RSD/yr (~USD 240) for agricultural machinery; 12,000 RSD/month. VAT basis not stated
markers.user_note: Accounts are opened by request to the operator, and the site asks for a company name — though the terms attach no professional or company condition. They also commit the operator to repairing a failed station within five days, force majeure aside.

markers.name: VekomNet
markers.yearly_cost: 135,410 RSD/yr incl. VAT (~USD 1,310); 24,620 RSD/month; 1,500 RSD/day
markers.user_note: The price list is headed with the reference to the state's own fee schedule for these services rather than a tariff of the operator's own, and moves with that schedule's adjustments.

markers.name: RTK2go
markers.region: worldwide, wherever a volunteer runs a base
markers.user_note: Registering a base asks for no evidence of where its antenna stands — no survey record, no PPP report — and a rover is positioned against whatever it broadcasts. A client that keeps retrying a dead mountpoint has its address blocked for hours.

markers.name: RTK.ie
markers.yearly_cost: €590/yr for 60 hours or €2,000/yr unlimited; €120 for 14 days unlimited. VAT basis not stated.
markers.user_note: A free trial exists, arranged through a demo request rather than the self-service checkout the paid tiers use.

markers.name: RTKNet
markers.yearly_cost: RUB 30,000/yr (~USD 350); 1 month RUB 4,000; 1 day RUB 400

markers.name: Roscadastre (ССТП)
markers.user_note: The sign-up form only accepts payment from a company or a registered sole trader, leaving a private individual no route in.

markers.name: SAPOS Baden-Württemberg
markers.user_note: A one-time administrative fee of €150 (incl. VAT) applies per access credential issued.

markers.name: SAPOS Bayern
markers.yearly_cost: €20/yr flat per account (covers real-time RTK and post-processing data)

markers.name: SAPOS GeoNord Open Data
markers.user_note: The open-data access is a single network-wide mountpoint — no per-station stream choice.

markers.name: SAPOS Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
markers.user_note: A one-time €100 administrative fee is charged per user at registration. The operator assigns each account to one of the two real-time services — Open RTK (openrtk mounts) or the surveying service HEPS (VRS mounts), not both.

markers.name: SAPOS Rheinland-Pfalz
markers.yearly_cost: €120/yr per account (HEPS) + €100 one-time setup
markers.user_note: Cancellation takes effect only at year-end (31 December).

markers.name: SAPOS Thüringen
markers.user_note: Corrections are released only to rovers reporting a position inside Thüringen. The operator offers the published Gast login for temporary and test access, with registered accounts for regular use.

markers.name: Zentrale Stelle SAPOS (ZSS)
markers.yearly_cost: HEPS €120/yr (billed €10/month per user ID) + €100 one-time admin fee; post-processing (GPPS) €10/month per station used
markers.user_note: One account, no separate registrations with the individual state SAPOS services.

markers.name: SARNET
markers.yearly_cost: €250/yr ex-VAT per receiver (~€305 incl. VAT)
markers.user_note: Grew out of a 2006–07 university research project and is now carried by a small instrument dealer; the caster address is not published and comes with the quote, and the station figures on its pages are still the 2008–2010 ones.

markers.name: SatRef
markers.user_note: The network solution is the one part that needs an account — free, from the Survey and Mapping Office by emailed application form, and it runs on a separate address from the open per-station streams.

markers.name: Sudan — no public RTK network
markers.user_note: The survey authority built the national frame as fixed ground markers and was still only considering permanent stations when war broke out in 2023; Khartoum, where it sits, was fought over until 2025.

markers.name: SWEPOS Network RTK
markers.yearly_cost: SEK 12,000/yr (~USD 1,265); SEK 5,000 per 90 days; SEK 2,000 per 30 days — all unlimited data, ex-VAT (25%)
markers.user_note: New customers get a 10-day free trial. The SEK 5,000 pott meters time rather than days: 1,000 minutes of connection — 16 h 40 min — lapsing after twelve months.
markers.datum_epoch: SWEREF 99, the Swedish realisation of ETRS89; internal epoch 1999.5

markers.name: SWEPOS daily RINEX
markers.user_note: Only the daily files are free; the SEK 1,000/yr tier adds hourly and virtual RINEX, a coordinate computation service and the station coordinates — which the operator also publishes on its public station page.
markers.datum_epoch: SWEREF 99, the Swedish realisation of ETRS89; internal epoch 1999.5

markers.name: SENCORS
markers.yearly_cost: 400,000 per 90 days, the portal's only plan — the figure is printed with no currency; read as XOF that is ~USD 680, or ~USD 2,700/yr
markers.user_note: Registration asks for a name, e-mail and company — nothing about a licence, an ID or a surveying practice. Ordering a subscription then happens behind that login.

markers.name: SERVIR
markers.yearly_cost: EUR 600/yr, EUR 150/30 days, or EUR 95 for 24 hours of connection time usable within a year, all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Subscriptions are paid by bank transfer, with credentials issued within three working days of proof of payment, and carry one connection at a time. Teaching and research institutions can get a free subscription on proof of purpose.
markers.datum_epoch: ITRF2008, epoch 2005.0 — the frame of both the station coordinates and the broadcast corrections; PT-TM06/ETRS89 is offered as an alternative output

markers.name: SiReNT
markers.yearly_cost: S$107/month per account (~USD 960/yr), GST included; one-time S$32.10 admin fee
markers.user_note: Sign-up runs through SingPass or CorpPass, so it needs a Singapore identity or a locally registered business; there is no email-only account. A three-day trial is available once a calendar month.
markers.datum_epoch: SVY21; corrections are broadcast in a WGS84 realisation and converted in the rover

markers.name: SGS42 (Kuzbass)
markers.yearly_cost: RUB 27,000/yr (~USD 318); RUB 200/day (RTK+RINEX)
markers.user_note: Run by Kemerovo State University and registered in Russia's federal spatial-data fund.
markers.datum_epoch: ГСК-2011 (2011.0); also outputs СК-95, СК-42 and МСК-42

markers.name: SIGNAL
markers.yearly_cost: €829.44/yr per GNSS device, or €0.12/min while connected with no subscription or minimum; observation files for post-processing €0.26 per second of conversion, about €4.21 per station-hour; all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Students, public bodies and associations certified as operating in the public interest pay nothing, on documentary proof. Signing up runs on paper either way: a signed contract goes by post, and credentials come back by e-mail.

markers.name: SIRGAS-Chile (Instituto Geográfico Militar)
