markers.user_note: The account and the observation files are free; certified coordinate documents are a separate product the institute sells.

markers.name: SKPOS
markers.yearly_cost: €70/yr; €25/month; €140/yr for two devices
markers.user_note: Open to private individuals; no trade licence or Slovak residency required. The subscription also carries 50 hours a year of RINEX download per receiver for post-processing, limited to data under six months old.

markers.name: National GNSS CORS Network
markers.user_note: The stations have been in technical operation since June 2025; no caster address, sign-up route or price has been published.

markers.name: SmartFix
markers.yearly_cost: NZD 50 (~USD 30) per day or part-day pay-as-you-go, invoiced monthly for the days used; annual and enterprise tiers price on request.
markers.user_note: Its network mixes Global Survey's own stations with the LINZ CORS that PositioNZ-RT also streams free. The 30-day trial takes no credit card.

markers.name: SmartNet RTK (Russia)
markers.yearly_cost: RUB 41,900/yr (~USD 493); 1 month RUB 4,500; 1 day RUB 420; from RUB 149/hour
markers.user_note: Despite the name this is no longer Hexagon's SmartNet: an independent Russian operator bought the stations in 2023. Invoicing asks for company registration details.

markers.name: Mosgorgeotrest (Moscow city network)
markers.user_note: Access requires a service contract and a power of attorney filed in person at the Mosgorgeotrest office.

markers.name: Somalia — no public RTK network
markers.user_note: No single national mapping or survey authority has succeeded the one lost in the 1991 state collapse; land administration is split between the Federal Government, Somaliland and Puntland.

markers.name: Survey of Israel (MAPI)
markers.yearly_cost: 3,600 ILS/yr (300 ILS/month, ~USD 1,200); no VAT is charged
markers.user_note: The operator supplies the mobile data SIM with the subscription, from one of three Israeli carriers. Sign-up is self-service and open to Israeli citizens, and the service is billed only when used.

markers.name: SpiderNet
markers.yearly_cost: price on request

markers.name: South Sudan — no public RTK network
markers.user_note: Independent since 2011 and at civil war from 2013, with fighting recurring after the 2018 peace deal; the institutional base for a national geodetic service has not been built in that time.

markers.name: Instituto Geográfico y del Catastro Nacional
markers.user_note: A RINEX data request costs USD 11.50 and is made in person at the institute's sales department in San Salvador.

markers.name: Survey3G
markers.yearly_cost: USD 450/yr; USD 45/30 days; USD 15/7 days
markers.user_note: Subscriptions are arranged by e-mail or WhatsApp rather than bought online; the login follows payment, a first activation takes about two days, and a subscription runs to fixed dates without auto-renewal.

markers.name: swipos
markers.yearly_cost: CHF 1,500/yr flat for the 1st licence, CHF 600 for a 2nd or 3rd, or CHF 0.50/min pay-per-use (CHF 30/h) — all ex-VAT
markers.user_note: Marketed to professional users, but the terms of use set no professional or company condition.
markers.datum_epoch: CHTRS95 = ETRS89(ETRF93) at 1993.0; heights LHN95 or LN02 by mountpoint; Liechtenstein's official heights are LN02

markers.name: Kadaster Sint Maarten CORS
markers.yearly_cost: XCG 3,600/yr (~USD 2,022); XCG 360/month (~USD 202)
markers.user_note: The operator's public pages carry the tariff and nothing else: no host or port, no stream format, no reference frame, and no statement of whether a subscription covers one receiver or a whole firm. There is no online sign-up.

markers.name: Syria — no public network
markers.user_note: The state body that held the national mapping remit was built for satellite imagery rather than reference stations, and no geodetic programme has been announced since the December 2024 change of government.

markers.name: EarthScope Providenciales station
markers.user_note: EarthScope's archive asks for a free account; the same daily files are mirrored without one by the Scripps archive at UC San Diego. Its site log gives only an approximate position — precise coordinates come from Nevada Geodetic Laboratory solutions.

markers.name: Survey and Mapping Department reference network
markers.user_note: The stations were installed by 2024 but the network has never been switched on — the department's own project report leaves each one waiting for a fixed internet address. Free use for all was the stated launch intent, not a commitment.

markers.name: Tencent RTK (腾讯网络RTK)
markers.yearly_cost: CNY 998.88/yr (~USD 140); CNY 128.88/month; CNY 7.88/day
markers.user_note: Resellers sell ready-registered year accounts; signing up with Tencent direct needs a Chinese mobile number and a real-name identity check.

markers.name: LandGNSS (Department of Lands)
markers.user_note: Sign-up validates a 13-digit Thai national ID; without one there is no path in. The network runs as zone casters split over two addresses, and the one here serves the central zone; other zones answer on their own host and port.

markers.name: Turkmenistan cadastre CORS
markers.user_note: Built 2022-2025 with FAO support, under the Ministry of Agriculture's Land Resources Service. The government has announced no public positioning access to it.

markers.name: TopNET
markers.yearly_cost: RUB 35,990/yr incl. VAT (~USD 423); 1 month RUB 4,148; 1 day RUB 427 (RUB 290 paid online)
markers.user_note: Sign-up is a written application by email rather than instant checkout, and it asks for an organisation name. Two weeks of free testing come first.

markers.name: TUSAGA-Aktif (CORS-TR)
markers.yearly_cost: ₺8,135/yr (~$178) or ₺1,000/mo, VAT incl.; plus a required one-off ₺550 device fee (~$12)
markers.user_note: An individual account needs no surveying licence. Sign-up uses a Turkish national ID number (TC Kimlik No) as the tax number, and a signed copy of the user agreement must be posted to the operator.

markers.name: TUSAGA-Aktif RINEX
markers.user_note: The 30-second files cost nothing, but the account must carry a registered GNSS receiver and the operator's one-off ₺550 device subscription. 1-second data costs ₺4 per station-hour; sign-up uses a Turkish national ID (TC Kimlik No).

markers.name: TrigNet
markers.user_note: Most stations send GPS and GLONASS only, with Galileo and BeiDou switched off at all but two sites. Positions come out about 0.66 m from the legacy Hartebeesthoek94 beacons and mapping, 0.78 m at worst, with no warning at the receiver.

markers.name: EarthScope Trinidad RINEX
markers.user_note: The files reach the public through the US National Geodetic Survey's archive — no account, and without the non-commercial licence that EarthScope's live correction streams require. Each day's file appears a day or two after it was recorded.

markers.name: TTAGN (Trinidad and Tobago Active Geodetic Network)
markers.user_note: The government page that names this network publishes no host, port, terms or price, and every page of the portal it links to — login and registration included — answers with an application error.

markers.name: Ministry of Lands reference network
markers.user_note: The World Bank project that paid for the stations reported them installed and transmitting in 2025; since then the Ministry of Lands has published no address, tariff, account form or terms for them.

markers.name: GeoTerrace (Lviv Polytechnic)
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Registration is open to anyone and covers real-time corrections, the RINEX archive, or both, but the terms for each — price included — are settled in a separate agreement made afterwards.

markers.name: Kyivstar mAgri.RTK
markers.yearly_cost: UAH 17,700/yr (~USD 420); UAH 12,500/yr through equipment shops; UAH 450/day
markers.user_note: Kyivstar publishes no coverage map or station list; a UAH 2 Try&Buy tariff runs the service for seven days.

markers.name: RTK HUB
markers.user_note: Nothing about the station locations is published — no map, no town names — and the caster address itself is issued only once an account is active.

markers.name: System.NET
markers.yearly_cost: UAH 21,120/yr (~USD 500); regional packages UAH 13,000–13,500/yr; UAH 1,470/7d
markers.user_note: Its gpsgeometer, agrortk and gnss-rtk shops all sell this one network, not separate services. The cheaper regional packages work only in the oblasts each one lists.

markers.name: Occupied and front-line Ukraine
markers.user_note: Reference stations across the occupied and front-line east and south were damaged or left unreachable, and operator station lists can still carry them. Networks across the country pause or lose capacity during air-raid alerts.

markers.name: ZAKPOS
markers.user_note: Ukraine's first permanent reference-station network, run by a state enterprise. Its caster stopped answering in May 2026, and its own portal map reports no stations.

markers.name: UGRF — Uganda Geodetic Reference Frame
markers.user_note: Corrections and post-processing work only for positions inside Uganda. The portal advertises five constellations, but NEAREST alone carries BeiDou, network-RTK streams stop at GPS and GLONASS, and iMAX_RTCM carries GPS only.

creds.userNote: set at sign-up — need not match your portal login

markers.name: ACORN (Alaska)
markers.user_note: Network RTK runs in regional zones whose boundaries and station make-up are not published; everywhere else the MS mounts hand the rover its nearest single base.

markers.name: AlCORS
markers.user_note: Registration asks for a company name, but there is no professional requirement; hobbyists report registering successfully.

markers.name: AlphaRTK
markers.yearly_cost: USD 995/yr; USD 695 / 6 mo; USD 195 / mo

markers.name: ARDOT RTN
markers.user_note: No web sign-up — a signed user agreement is returned by email or post, then ARDOT issues credentials.

markers.name: C4Gnet
markers.yearly_cost: $495/yr (10 h RTK/yr), $1,995/yr (50 h/yr), $3,500/yr unlimited

markers.name: CRTN
markers.user_note: Access is a one-time USD 100 processing fee (waived for universities and schools) with no annual charge.
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(2011), broadcast as CSRS Epoch 2025.00 (California Spatial Reference System, not Canadian NAD83(CSRS))

markers.name: ACORN (Connecticut)
markers.user_note: One account allows only one connection at a time.

markers.name: eGPS Solutions
markers.region: Georgia and parts of the neighbouring Southeast
markers.yearly_cost: USD 1,650/yr (VRS); USD 50/day capped at USD 400/mo; agriculture tier USD 1,000/yr

markers.name: FPRN
markers.region: Florida, edging into south Georgia and south Alabama
markers.user_note: There is no professional requirement, and the operator states there are no plans to charge.
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(2011) epoch 2010.0; NATRF2022, WGS84(G2296) and ITRF2020 served on separate ports

markers.name: IaRTN
markers.region: Iowa, reaching Omaha, Sioux Falls and Dakota Dunes

markers.name: ILDOT CORS
markers.user_note: Accounts are issued on request — the portal has no self-service sign-up — and the operator publishes no service name, terms or reference frame.

markers.name: InCORS
markers.user_note: The signup is a printed, signed agreement returned by post, fax or email; the form is organisation-shaped but the general public is explicitly welcome.

markers.name: KeyNetGPS
markers.yearly_cost: USD 3,135/yr (net 30) or USD 3,300/yr paid monthly at USD 275/mo; USD 375 / 30 days
markers.user_note: Sold both direct and through resellers (Laser Industries, Duncan-Parnell); it is the same operator's network either way.

markers.name: KyCORS
markers.user_note: Each registration is approved by hand rather than automatically; the portal itself warns it is often slow to respond.

markers.name: LVVWD GPS Base Station Network
markers.user_note: 19 stations of the Las Vegas Valley Water District, with a network-RTK product. Access is by application to the District Surveyor; the request form invokes Nevada's land-survey statute, lists drone use among its purposes and names no fee.

markers.name: MaCORS
markers.user_note: The NTRIP port returns nothing without a login.

markers.name: MaineDOT RTN
markers.user_note: The network solution pulls in cross-border stations in New Brunswick and Quebec.

markers.name: MDOT CORS (MSRN)
markers.user_note: The stream drops if the rover does not send its position (GGA) at least every 30 seconds.

markers.name: MnCORS
markers.region: Minnesota, reaching Fargo and Grand Forks in North Dakota
markers.user_note: Access stays live with at least one connection a year.

markers.name: MoDOT RTN
markers.region: Missouri, reaching the Kansas City metro's Kansas side
markers.user_note: The user agreement must be notarised before credentials are issued.

markers.name: MTSRN
markers.yearly_cost: $1,500/yr per login
markers.user_note: The archive of station data for post-processing is free; only live corrections carry the fee.

markers.name: NC RTN
markers.yearly_cost: USD 500 one-time first login (USD 250 each further login); static RINEX free; pay by cheque

markers.name: Nevada GPS Network
markers.region: Reno, Washoe County and northern Nevada
markers.yearly_cost: USD 600/yr per login; the same subscription also covers Utah's TURN GPS network
markers.user_note: Sign-up needs a free Utah ID account (the network is run by Utah's geospatial centre); no residency requirement appears in the signup terms.
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(2011) epoch 2010.00; a legacy NAD83/HARN stream is also served

markers.name: NOAA CORS Network
markers.region: the United States, including Alaska and Hawaii
markers.user_note: Downloads are open with no account, and NOAA's free OPUS service turns a submitted observation file into a NAD83(2011) position.

markers.name: National Park Service GNSS
markers.region: US national parks, including the Pacific and Caribbean territories
markers.user_note: Live corrections are for park staff and partners only; the open channel is the archive — free hourly raw files from ~130 park stations, including Guam, Saipan, American Samoa, Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands, Hawaii and remote Alaska. No account.
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(2011); NAD83(PA11) Hawaii/American Samoa; NAD83(MA11) Guam/Saipan — all epoch 2010.0

markers.name: NYSNet
markers.region: New York, edging into northern New Jersey

markers.name: ODOT RTN
markers.user_note: No self-service signup — access is requested through a web form and a login is then issued.

markers.name: Plains farm RTK (receiver-locked)
markers.user_note: RTK blankets this farm belt, but captively: John Deere channels serve only StarFire receivers and the dealer radio bases are as closed. ND, SD, NE and KS fund no public network; Nebraska state stations reach the public only as raw data archives.

markers.name: Point One Polaris
markers.region: the United States nationwide, also Europe and parts of Asia-Pacific
markers.yearly_cost: USD 125/mo; ~USD 1,200/yr on annual billing
markers.user_note: No station list or state-by-state extent is published; the operator's coverage map is the only account of where its bases stand. A 14-day trial needs no card.

markers.name: Premium Positioning RTK Premium
markers.region: 48 US states (all but Alaska and Hawaii); also sold across Europe and Canada
markers.yearly_cost: USD 900/yr; USD 250/3 months; USD 100/mo (US reseller E38)
markers.user_note: No US reference frame is declared (the operator documents only European ETRS89) and no station density is published; in six states service is nearest-base rather than network RTK. Sold in the US through reseller E38.

markers.name: SCRTN
markers.yearly_cost: USD 600 per subscription per year, paid at application, no refunds

markers.name: TDOT GNSS Reference Network
markers.yearly_cost: USD 450/yr (USD 37.50 per month per simultaneous access point); pay via portal (WorldPay)
markers.datum_epoch: NAD83(NA2011)(MYCS2) epoch 2010.00; legacy NAD83(CORS96) epoch 1996.00 mounts in parallel

markers.name: Trimble VRS Now
markers.yearly_cost: price on request (dealer quote); indications ~USD 1,200-1,500/yr
markers.user_note: Bought through Trimble dealers on quote — no US price and no state-by-state coverage list is published. The one documented dense pocket is the absorbed MidStates network: all of North Dakota and eastern South Dakota.

markers.name: TURN GPS
markers.region: Utah, edging into southern Idaho, western Wyoming and southern Nevada
markers.yearly_cost: $600/yr per login (bundles Utah + Reno-area Nevada)
markers.user_note: Access needs a free Utah digital ID account; no residency requirement appears in the signup terms.

markers.name: TxDOT RTN
markers.user_note: Open only to TxDOT staff and contractors on department-funded projects. Publicly, the base-station data is offered only as static reference points for post-processing, not live corrections.

markers.name: VECTOR
markers.user_note: Only the Trimble-proprietary streams carry all constellations; a non-Trimble rover receives GPS and GLONASS corrections only.

markers.name: WISCORS
markers.user_note: Wisconsin's administrative code sets a USD 300 per user per year fee for the network, but the registration form has no payment step and the operator's own FAQ describes none.

markers.name: WSRN
markers.yearly_cost: $1,900/yr per login (non-partner)
markers.user_note: A one-time 90-day test account (once per individual or firm) is offered before any paid subscription.

markers.name: WVRTN
markers.region: West Virginia, reaching Maryland's western panhandle
markers.user_note: Registration asks for an organisation but no professional licence or fee; the operator says nothing about whether individuals qualify.

markers.name: Universidad de Santiago de Chile (USACH)
markers.user_note: The caster is the station's own upstream feed to the international research networks; nothing the university publishes describes the stream, sets terms for it or states an uptime.

markers.name: UZPOS
markers.user_note: Part of the state cadastre system, serving government bodies and licensed surveyors; the agency publishes no tariff or access route for it.

markers.name: VNGEONET
markers.yearly_cost: VND 6,750,000/yr per receiver (~USD 265); VND 4,280,000/6 mo (~USD 168); VND 750,000/mo (~USD 29); free where the stations average more than 80 km apart
markers.user_note: The corrections carry a WGS84-to-VN2000 transform that most low-cost rovers ignore, leaving their output in WGS84; the operator puts the difference from VN2000 at 30-40 cm or more.

markers.name: Irkutsk reference station (ВНИИФТРИ)
markers.yearly_cost: Price on request
markers.user_note: Access is arranged by email with the institute rather than through an online sign-up, with a free week first.

markers.name: GeoNet Kosova
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: The subscription form takes private applicants as well as companies. The only price shown on the site is a promotion that expired in January 2022.

markers.name: KOPOS
markers.yearly_cost: €400/yr, €250/6 mo, €60/mo; €20 one-off registration
markers.user_note: RINEX post-processing is a separate subscription at €100/yr. The network solution runs over sixteen points: the operator's own eight plus eight taken in from neighbouring national networks under data-exchange agreements.

markers.name: Yemen — no public RTK network
markers.user_note: Yemen's survey authority never published a real-time correction stream, and the war since 2015 has left surveying administration split between rival authorities in Sanaa and Aden.

markers.name: CNH Industrial RTK+
markers.yearly_cost: price on request
markers.user_note: Sold only as a dealer subscription through Case IH, New Holland and Steyr outlets; CNH's South African pages publish no signup form and no station list.

markers.name: ZINGSA CORS
markers.yearly_cost: US$200/yr flat statutory CORS fee (SI 47/2023)
markers.user_note: Free until 31 December 2026 under an operator trial; the statutory fee is waived for that period, not withdrawn.
markers.datum_epoch: ITRF2014 (2018-06-28); the NEAR-G4-ARC1950.35S stream serves ARC1950 instead.
